AI画面一律标注「AI情景重现 · 非历史影像」，不用AI伪造卡钦斯基正脸；真实身份只用有出处的FBI公开照片

chapters.title: 哈佛天才
chapters.text: 一九七八年到一九九六年，联邦调查局经历了持续时间最长、代价最高昂的追捕之一。凶手不是街头暴徒，而是智商高达一百六十七的哈佛数学天才：西奥多·卡钦斯基。他隐居蒙大拿林间的简陋木屋，把精心制作的邮包寄向全美大学与航空业。科技界开始闻风丧胆。

chapters.title: 十七年
chapters.text: 十七年间，他寄出或亲手放置了十六枚装置，三人死亡，近二十二人受伤。联邦调查局联合烟酒枪械管理局与邮政稽查组成专案组，代号尤纳炸弹，专指大学与航空目标。装置用随处可寻的废料制成，几乎不留痕迹。名单甚至来自图书馆的随机检索。专案组一度扩充到一百五十人，仍找不到他。

chapters.title: 宣言
chapters.text: 一九九五年，他寄出约三万五千字的长文，要世人正视他的主张：工业科技正在毁灭人类。经过激烈争论，联邦调查局局长与司法部长同意发表，希望有读者能认出作者。《华盛顿邮报》刊出后，线索如潮水涌来。真正打开缺口的，不是新的物证。

chapters.title: 文风
chapters.text: 他的弟弟戴维提供了哥哥的书信与文稿。语言分析认定：那些私信，与宣言几乎出自同一人。再叠上芝加哥成长、伯克利任教、盐湖城停留、最终隐居蒙大拿——搜查令的事实基础，第一次被写实。高科技追踪十七年无果，破局靠的是文风。

chapters.title: 木屋
chapters.text: 一九九六年四月三日，调查人员在林肯镇附近十英尺乘十四英尺的木屋里逮捕了他。屋内有大量零件、四万页手写笔记，以及一枚已准备寄出的装置。持续十七年的恐慌结束了。破案的关键，是亲弟弟从字里行间认出独特文风，选择大义灭亲。

chapters.title: 独狼
chapters.text: 一九九八年一月，他认罪。此后在科罗拉多超级监狱度过余生。联邦调查局称他为终极独狼。十七年间最昂贵的追捕，最后不是靠卫星或数据库，而是一篇公开发表的宣言，和一次家人的指认。卡钦斯基证明：最危险的，有时不是街头，而是一间与世隔绝的小屋。

shots.prompt: Wide establishing view of a remote Montana mountain forest at overcast late afternoon, lodgepole pines, a small primitive unpainted wood cabin half-hidden among trees, no people, no vehicles. Start wide and slowly dolly toward the cabin; end on the dark doorway. Quiet isolation, not horror.
shots.purpose: 地点建立：蒙大拿林间木屋

shots.prompt: Wide establishing view of a quiet American university quadrangle in the early 1960s, brick halls, autumn trees, a few distant unidentifiable students walking away from camera, no famous campus signage, no readable letters. Slow push toward empty steps. Period clothing only. Do not show a recognizable historical person.
shots.purpose: 人设反差：校园与天才背景，不扮演本人
shots.transition_out: 浅色砖墙匹配信息卡纸色

shots.purpose: 不展示暴力，以事实卡确认追捕跨度
shots.transition_out: 低频音桥带入木屋近景

shots.prompt: Closer exterior of the same primitive weathered 10-by-14-foot unpainted wood cabin among lodgepole pines in the Montana mountains, tiny four-pane window, corrugated metal roof, no electricity wires, no satellite dish, late 20th century.  Overcast mountain light, wood grain and rusted nail heads visible. Camera slowly approaches the closed plank door. No people, no tools laid out as weapons, no packages.
shots.purpose: 木屋近景：隐居十七年的空间

shots.prompt: A quiet 1980s American residential street at pale morning, a dark green period mail truck parked far in the background, no logos readable. In the foreground on a wooden porch sits one closed brown-paper parcel tied with ordinary twine, unopened. Camera slowly pushes toward the closed parcel. No smoke, no damage, no interior of the parcel.
shots.purpose: 邮包作为作案通道；只拍未开启的外观
shots.transition_out: 纸张声提前进入调查组

shots.prompt: A fictional composite middle-aged male investigator, clean-shaven, short neatly combed dark hair, charcoal wool suit, off-white shirt, plain dark tie, no hat indoors, a sand-colored trench coat outdoors. Mostly rear three-quarter view in a modest 1980s federal task-force room: cork boards with blank ivory cards, a wall map of the United States with no labels, several analog telephones. He pins one blank card and pauses. Slow lateral move. No mugshots, no readable names.
shots.purpose: UNABOM专案组成立
shots.transition_out: 动作匹配：手→桌面上的邮包

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. Close overhead shot of one closed brown-paper parcel lying on the ivory folder, twine intact, no address writing, no stamps with letters. Warm lamp, cool window. Camera slowly pushes toward the paper fibers. No hands opening it, nothing ominous physically happens.
shots.purpose: 只展示封闭邮包，不展示内部
十六枚、三死、近二十二伤；来源FBI

shots.prompt: Empty late-1970s university engineering corridor with cream walls, dark wood doors, a drinking fountain, fluorescent practical light. No people. Camera slowly travels the empty hall toward a closed door. Quiet institutional unease, not a crime reconstruction.
shots.purpose: 大学目标；不重现爆炸

shots.prompt: Interior of a 1980s American newspaper printing room, a heavy black rotary press slowly turns cream newsprint. Focus on moving paper and ink texture, entirely illegible print, no fake headlines. Camera tracks with the paper. Warm tungsten light.
shots.purpose: 社会恐慌与媒体；标题后期叠加
shots.transition_out: 纸页声接专案组信息卡

shots.purpose: 专案组构成与规模

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. A thick stack of cream typescript pages sits under the green lamp, type completely illegible, no manifesto title. One white cotton-gloved hand squares the stack. Macro push from paper edge to fiber. No readable letters.
shots.purpose: 三万五千字长文作为物证外观

shots.prompt: A 1995 American newspaper city desk at night, CRT monitors dark or showing unreadable snow, stacks of paper, one editor seen from behind in shirtsleeves. No masthead, no logos. Slow dolly past the desk toward a window. Restrained.
shots.purpose: 刊出宣言的新闻机构意象
宣言发表是破案转折，不是让步恐怖分子的结论

shots.prompt: A modest 1995 American suburban kitchen, warm practical light. One adult man in a plain plaid shirt seen ONLY FROM BEHIND sits at a wooden table reading a newspaper whose print is entirely illegible. He is a composite stand-in, not a celebrity impersonation, not Theodore Kaczynski. Camera slowly moves around his shoulder without showing a full face.
shots.purpose: 弟弟读报认出文风的意象，不扮演真人正脸

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. Two small stacks of cream personal letters lie side by side under the green lamp, handwriting rendered as abstract marks only. A single white cotton-gloved right hand turns one page. Slow macro. No readable text.
shots.purpose: 弟弟提供书信与文稿

shots.prompt: A fictional composite middle-aged male investigator, clean-shaven, short neatly combed dark hair, charcoal wool suit, off-white shirt, plain dark tie, no hat indoors, a sand-colored trench coat outdoors. The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. He stands at the desk comparing two unlabeled pages, rear three-quarter view. He does not circle a name. Camera moves subtly sideways to show the gap between pages. Thoughtful, not triumphant.
shots.purpose: 语言分析指向同一作者
破案关键：文风与生平重叠

shots.prompt: A wet dirt forest road in the Montana mountains under low clouds, two unmarked 1990s dark sedans parked far away among pines, no police light bars, no readable markings. Camera slowly moves toward the distant cabin roof. No raid action, no weapons.
shots.purpose: 搜查令落地前的接近

shots.prompt: Interior of the tiny primitive cabin: wood stove, rough shelves of unlabeled notebooks with completely unreadable handwriting, a single chair, dim daylight from a small window. No people, no mechanical parts, no packages. Slow rise of an overhead-ish camera. Isolation, not a trophy display of devices.
shots.purpose: 四万页笔记的空间；不展示装置内部
逮捕日期与地点
使用FBI公开逮捕照片介绍真实身份
shots.transition_out: 旁白连续，肖像切监狱外景

shots.prompt: Distant exterior of a high-security prison complex on a dry high-plains landscape under hard sunlight, inspired by a Supermax facility in Colorado, no readable signs, no close faces, no guards in combat poses. Very slow pullback. Documentary distance.
shots.purpose: 认罪后的关押地意象

shots.prompt: Close view of a vintage black typewriter on a dark desk, two ordinary adult hands type a few slow keystrokes on completely unreadable cream paper. Camera shifts focus from keys to the blank upper margin. Restrained tungsten side light.
shots.purpose: 独狼与文字；与宣言主题回扣

shots.prompt: From just inside the same primitive cabin, looking out the open plank doorway to pale pines and overcast sky. No person in the door. Slow push toward the light. Human absence rather than horror.
shots.purpose: 大义灭亲之后的空屋

shots.prompt: The same dark walnut investigation desk with an ivory closed case folder, a single silver paperclip, and an emerald-green glass banker lamp at the upper left. The ivory investigation folder lies OPEN with a few cream pages inside, abstract black marks only, no names. One hand in a charcoal suit sleeve gently squares the papers but leaves the folder open. Overhead camera slowly rises. Do not close or seal the file.
shots.purpose: 已知事实汇总；不做炫耀结案

shots.prompt: Montana pine forest at dusk, the tiny cabin visible as a dark rectangle among trees, a thin thread of wood-stove smoke. No people. Slow controlled pullback leaves the cabin small in the frame.
shots.purpose: 回到林中小屋
shots.transition_out: 同向光线切更远的木屋

shots.prompt: Even wider view of the same mountain valley, the cabin now a tiny mark among pines, late-afternoon sidelight. Camera almost imperceptibly pulls back. Quiet landscape, not a chase.
shots.purpose: 与世隔绝的空间

shots.prompt: An empty late-1970s university corridor matching the earlier hall, daylight at the far door. No people. Camera gently moves toward the vacant pool of daylight.
shots.purpose: 从案件称呼回到被波及的日常空间

shots.prompt: A quiet empty wooden chair beside the small cabin window and a rough table. On the table, only a closed unmarked notebook. Soft late light, camera almost imperceptibly pulls back. No person, no writing, no flower as fake evidence. End in quiet stillness.
shots.purpose: 收束：小屋仍在，人不在
shots.transition_out: 最后0.8秒音画渐隐，精确180秒结束
